Auth.subtitle: Sign in to continue your SmartLearn Ethiopia journey
Auth.forgotPasswordTooltip: Click to request a password recovery via your school system administrator.
Auth.forgotPasswordModalIntro: Enter your registered email address below to submit a password or 6-digit access code recovery request to the System Administrator.
Auth.forgotPasswordSuccessMessage: Your password recovery request has been logged for the System Administrator (habteofat@gmail.com). Please contact the Admin office to receive your updated 6-digit access code.
Auth.forgotPasswordStep1: 1. Submit your registered email address above so the System Administrator is notified.
Auth.forgotPasswordStep2: 2. The Administrator verifies your school ID and resets your 6-digit role access code (STU, TEA, FIN, or LIN).
Auth.forgotPasswordStep3: 3. Sign in with the newly issued password or 6-digit access code provided by the administrator.
Auth.languageToggleLabel: Switch language between English and Amharic

Errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address or admin-registered access code.
Errors.invalidPassword: Please enter your password (at least 4 characters).
Errors.invalidCredentials: Only emails or 6-digit access codes registered in the Admin system can log in.
